description.zh:
* 是否是手写表格，默认不是。
* true：是手写表格；false：不是手写表格。
* 注意：该字段是字符串类型。
description.en:
* Indicates whether the table contains handwriting. The default value is false.  
* true: The table contains handwriting.  
* false: The table does not contain handwriting.  
* Note: This field is of the string type.

description.zh:
* 是否无线条或者只有横线没有竖线,默认有线条。
* true：无线条；false：有线条。
description.en:
* Indicates whether the table has no lines or only horizontal lines without VERTICAL LINEs. The default value is false, which means the table has lines.  
* true: The table has no lines.  
* false: The table has lines.

description.zh:
* 是否需要自动旋转功能，默认需要。
* true：需要；false：不需要。
description.en:
* Indicates whether automatic rotation is required. The default value is true.  
* true: Automatic rotation is required.  
* false: Automatic rotation is not required.

description.zh:
* 是否跳过检测，默认为false。
* true：跳过检查；false：不跳过检查。
description.en:
* Indicates whether detection is skipped. The default value is false.  
* true: Skips detection.  
* false: Does not skip detection.

description.zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* You must specify either this field or the body field. You cannot specify both fields or leave both fields empty.  
* Image URL (up to 2048 characters in length; Base64 encoding is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* You must specify either this field or the URL field. You cannot specify both fields or leave both fields empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When using HTTP to invoke the API, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK) to invoke the API, place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云表格识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，支持对多种表格格式（有线表格、条纹表格、无线表格）进行智能文字识别并结构化输出识别结果。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多格式|支持有线表格、条纹表格、无线表格、手写表格识别。| |全字段识别|智能识别图片上的表格所包含的全部字段。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |置信度对比|对低置信度文字进行标红处理，便于二次确认。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [通用文字识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=table#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[表格识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0075%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeTableOcr?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| 注：PDF文件格式的表格解析请点击[表格智能解析](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450742.html)快速了解
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Table Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product that supports intelligent text recognition of various table formats (lined tables, striped tables, and unlined tables) and provides structured output of the classification results. * Based on DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over years of development and offers several key advantages: stable service, ease of operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API |Category|Overview| |---|---------| |Multiple Formats|Supports recognition of lined tables, striped tables, unlined tables, and handwritten tables.| |Full Field Recognition|Intelligently recognizes all fields contained in the table within the image.| |Wide Coverage of Types|Supports recognition of low-quality images affected by blur, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds.| |Confidence Level Comparison|Highlights text with low confidence levels in red to facilitate secondary confirmation.| #### How to Use This API |Step|Overview| |--|---| |1|Activate the [General Text Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience the feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=table#intro).| |2|Purchase a [Table Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0075%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota that you can use for testing.| |3|Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeTableOcr?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the recognition result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the Resource Access Management (RAM) user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed authorization steps, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html).| #### Important Notes |Type|Overview| |----|-------------------| |Image Format|
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not currently supported.
| |Image Dimensions|
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 px.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| |Image File Size|
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
  • Images that are too small will negatively impact recognition accuracy. Best results occur when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| |Other Tips|
  • API response speed depends on the amount of text in the image—more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but these factors may still affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use images with high definition, no glare, and no distortion.
| Note: For parsing tables in PDF format, see [Intelligent Table Parsing](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450742.html) for quick guidance.
